questions.question: Two angles of a triangle measure 34 degrees and 46 degrees. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add to 180: 180 - 34 - 46 = 100.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: triangle angles always add up to 180.

questions.question: Two angles are complementary. One measures 20 degrees. What is the measure of the other?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles add to 90 degrees: 90 - 20 = 70.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: complementary adds to 90, like a corner.

questions.question: Three angles sit on a straight line. Two measure 32 degrees and 44 degrees. What is the third?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line add to 180: 180 - 32 - 44 = 104.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a straight line is 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the name of the line segment from the center of a circle to its edge?
questions.explanation: The radius runs from the center to any point on the circle; the diameter is twice as long and the chord joins two edge points.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: radius is half the diameter.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cube with an edge length of 7 cm?
questions.explanation: Volume = side cubed = 7 x 7 x 7 = 343 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: cube volume is side times side times side.

questions.question: What is the area of a parallelogram with a base of 10 cm and a height of 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of a parallelogram = base x height = 10 x 5 = 50 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a parallelogram has the area of a rectangle with the same base and height.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism that is 2 cm by 3 cm by 3 cm?
questions.explanation: Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(6 + 6 + 9) = 42 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: surface area adds up all six faces.

questions.question: Two triangles are similar. One has a side of 3 cm and the matching side on the other is 6 cm. If another side of the first triangle is 4 cm, what is the matching side?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is 2, so multiply 4 by 2 to get 8 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: similar figures keep the same shape, so sides scale together.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism that is 3 cm by 2 cm by 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(6 + 15 + 10) = 62 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: surface area adds up all six faces.

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 4 cm long, 3 cm wide, and 4 cm tall?
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 4 x 3 x 4 = 48 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: volume fills the box: length times width times height.

questions.question: What is the median of 2, 5, 4, 2, 5?
questions.explanation: Order the numbers first: 2, 2, 4, 5, 5. The middle one is 4.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: median is the middle value after sorting.

questions.question: What is the area of a circle with a radius of 3 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Area = pi x radius squared = 3.14 x 3 x 3 = 28.26 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circle area uses radius squared, not diameter.

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 6 cm and 10 cm and height 4 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x (base 1 + base 2) x height = 1/2 x 16 x 4 = 32 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a trapezoid averages its two bases, then multiplies by height.

questions.question: Two angles of a triangle measure 78 degrees and 62 degrees. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add to 180: 180 - 78 - 62 = 40.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: triangle angles always add up to 180.

questions.question: In which quadrant is the point (1, 6)?
questions.explanation: Both coordinates are positive, so the point is in Quadrant I.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrant I is the top-right, where both numbers are positive.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x 13 = 26 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: perimeter walks all the way around.

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 6 cm long, 4 cm wide, and 3 cm tall?
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 6 x 4 x 3 = 72 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: volume fills the box: length times width times height.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x 11 = 22 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: perimeter walks all the way around.

questions.question: What is the range of 3, 4, 11, 11, 8?
questions.explanation: Range = largest - smallest = 11 - 3 = 8.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: range shows how spread out the data is.

questions.question: Two vertical angles are formed by crossing lines. One measures 56 degrees. What does the other measure?
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are always equal, so the other is also 56 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: angles across from each other are twins.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a diameter of 10 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Circumference = pi x diameter = 3.14 x 10 = 31.4 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circumference is pi times the diameter.

questions.question: A circle has a radius of 12 cm. What is its diameter?
questions.explanation: The diameter is twice the radius: 2 x 12 = 24 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: diameter goes all the way across, radius only halfway.

questions.question: Three angles sit on a straight line. Two measure 42 degrees and 43 degrees. What is the third?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line add to 180: 180 - 42 - 43 = 95.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a straight line is 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is a polygon with 5 sides called?
questions.explanation: Penta- means five, so a 5-sided polygon is a pentagon.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: count the sides to name the polygon.

questions.question: In a survey, 40% of 200 students chose pizza. If the school has 100 students, about how many would choose pizza?
questions.explanation: 40% of 100 is about 40 students.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: use the sample percent to predict the whole group.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a diameter of 20 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.

questions.question: Two angles are supplementary. One measures 59 degrees. What is the measure of the other?
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add to 180 degrees: 180 - 59 = 121.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: supplementary adds to 180, like a straight line.

questions.question: Two vertical angles are formed by crossing lines. One measures 37 degrees. What does the other measure?
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are always equal, so the other is also 37 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: angles across from each other are twins.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a radius of 5 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.

questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circumference is the distance around the circle.

questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 6 cm and a height of 10 cm?

questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height.

questions.question: In which quadrant is the point (-2, 2)?

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 12 cm long and 4 cm wide?

questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circle area uses radius squared, not diameter.

questions.question: Two vertical angles are formed by crossing lines. One measures 64 degrees. What does the other measure?

questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: angles across from each other are twins.

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 6 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 2 cm tall?

questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: volume fills the box: length times width times height.

questions.question: Two angles are supplementary. One measures 57 degrees. What is the measure of the other?

questions.question: A shape is a rectangle 8 cm by 4 cm with a triangle on top that has a base of 6 cm and a height of 4 cm. What is the total area?

questions.question: What is the sum of the interior angles of a polygon with 5 sides?

questions.question: What is the surface area of a cube with an edge length of 4 cm?

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 10 cm long and 6 cm wide?

questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rectangle area is length times width.

questions.question: A triangular prism has a triangle base of 6 cm, a triangle height of 5 cm, and a prism length of 7 cm. What is its volume?

questions.question: Three angles of a quadrilateral measure 79, 85, and 67 degrees. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a quadrilateral add to 360: 360 - 79 - 85 - 67 = 129.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: four-sided figures have angles that add to 360.

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 6 cm and 12 cm and height 5 cm?

questions.question: A spinner with 4 equal sections: red, blue, green, yellow. What is the probability of landing on green?

questions.question: Which formula gives the area of a circle?

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a radius of 3 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 x pi x radius = 2 x 3.14 x 3 = 18.84 cm.

questions.question: Three angles sit on a straight line. Two measure 51 degrees and 67 degrees. What is the third?

questions.question: Two angles are supplementary. One measures 23 degrees. What is the measure of the other?
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add to 180 degrees: 180 - 23 = 157.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: supplementary adds to 180, like a straight line.

questions.question: A triangle with one angle of 90 degrees is called what kind of triangle?
questions.explanation: A triangle with one 90-degree angle is a right triangle - the right angle is the corner where two sides meet at 90 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a right angle makes a right triangle - look for the little square corner.

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 8 cm and 12 cm and height 4 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x (base 1 + base 2) x height = 1/2 x 20 x 4 = 40 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a trapezoid averages its two bases, then multiplies by height.

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 10 cm long and 7 cm wide?

questions.question: What is the surface area of a cube with an edge length of 3 cm?

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide?

questions.question: What is the median of 4, 2, 4, 2, 2?

questions.question: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism that is 4 cm by 4 cm by 2 cm?

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 3 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 3 cm tall?
